summary: The same request as json-output-en, filed by a person who is not on the requester allowlist. Scenario E6 submits it, and a variant with no factory label.

revisions.title: Add a JSON output option to the word count tool
body: Scripts that call the word count tool have to read its columns of numbers, and that breaks whenever the spacing changes. I would like an option that prints the same counts as a JSON object.

Add a `--json` option. With it, the tool prints one JSON object on standard output with the keys `lines`, `words` and `characters`, in that order. Without the option, the output stays exactly as it is today.

behavior: The factory rejects the request at admission. The job ends REJECTED and no stage run starts.
The reply on the issue is short and in plain English. It does not say which test failed, so a stranger learns nothing about the allowlist.
An audit event records the rejection with the requester, the time and the correlation id.
No agent, sandbox or model call happens for this request.
A request with no factory label is not accepted either, and is explained in the same way.
